macro.name: Carbohydrates
macro.what: The body's main fuel — rice, roti and millets feed working muscles all day.
macro.why: Children who miss steady carbohydrate often feel flat and tired through the school day.
macro.signs: Low energy, irritability, trouble concentrating through class or a shift.

macro.name: Protein
macro.what: Builds and repairs muscle, blood and immunity — building blocks are in every dal and curd cup.
macro.why: Growth years (children, teens, pregnancy) lean hardest on protein; plate what is there while it is fresh.
macro.signs: Slow growth, frequent infections, thinning hair and slow-healing cuts.

macro.name: Fats
macro.what: Concentrated energy plus the carrier for vitamins A, D, E and K — ghee, oil, nuts.
macro.why: Very little fat on a plate can leave vitamins unused; the right amount keeps a meal satisfying.
macro.signs: Dry skin, low energy density in meals, poor absorption of fat-soluble vitamins.

macro.name: Fibre
macro.what: Keeps digestion steady and slowly releases the energy in grains.
macro.why: Most Indian plates could use one more vegetable; rescued produce is often the easiest fibre win.
macro.signs: Irregular digestion, quick spikes and dips in energy after meals.

micro.name: Vitamins (A, B12, C)
micro.what: Vitamin A supports eyes, B12 builds blood and nerves, vitamin C helps iron absorb and immunity.
micro.why: Vitamin A and B12 shortfalls are common in cereal-heavy plates; adding greens, milk, curd or eggs covers a lot.
micro.signs: Night-vision trouble (A), tiredness from anaemia (B12), slow healing gums (C).

micro.name: Iron
micro.what: Carries oxygen in the blood — the century-old anaemia problem starts at the plate.
micro.why: Pairing iron-rich food with vitamin C (lemon, tomato) helps the body absorb more of it.
micro.signs: Fatigue, breathlessness, pale inner eyelids — tested, not diagnosed by eye.

micro.name: Calcium
micro.what: Builds bones that have to last a lifetime — childhood is when they are banked.
micro.why: Milk packs and curd on the board are direct calcium deliveries for growing kids.
micro.signs: Bone and tooth weakness in the long run.

micro.name: Zinc
micro.what: Grows tissue and guards immunity — famous for helping recovery and growth.
micro.why: Snacks are often zinc-poor; dals, seeds and milk lift a plate's zinc.
micro.signs: Slow growth, slow wound healing, taste dulled.

micro.name: Iodine
micro.what: Keeps the thyroid running right — which runs growth, energy and brain development.
micro.why: Iodised salt is the quiet hero; it is in every kitchen and mess we serve.
micro.signs: Goitre, low energy, slowed thinking — solved mostly by iodised salt.
